svg.title: European alliances, 1872–1907
svg.desc: Six historical schematics preserve the relationships and missing edges in Easley and Kleinberg Figure 5.5. Early stages are incomplete signed graphs; the final stage is complete with two internally friendly groups.
svg.text: GB: Great Britain · Fr: France · Ru: Russia
AH: Austria-Hungary · Ge: Germany · It: Italy
The balance theorem above applies to complete signed graphs.
